title: Kalunga2016 – SSVEP Exo dataset
description: The Kalunga2016 SSVEP Exo dataset comprises EEG recordings from 12 healthy subjects performing a steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. Subjects were seated in an electric wheelchair and instructed to focus on flickering LEDs at frequencies of 13 Hz, 17 Hz, or 21 Hz, or to maintain fixation on a central point for the rest class. The dataset contains 8 EEG channels recorded at 256 Hz with a standard 10-05 montage, designed to evaluate online SSVEP-based BCI performance using Riemannian geometry classification methods for assistive robotics applications.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.tec MobiLab amplifier with 8 electrodes (Oz, O1, O2, POz, PO3, PO4, PO7, PO8) positioned according to the standard 10-05 montage with right mastoid reference. Sampling rate was 256 Hz. Subjects performed 32 trials per session (8 trials per visual stimulus frequency: 13 Hz, 17 Hz, 21 Hz, and 8 rest trials), with each trial lasting 6 seconds and a 3-second inter-trial interval. Visual stimuli were presented via LED panels positioned on the left side of the wheelchair.
